items.text: Add the date 2026-11-12: “EU ETS provisional agreement reached on boosting free carbon allowances”
items.reason: Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on 12 November 2026 to boost free carbon allowances for energy-intensive industries.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-19: “SFDR 2.0 provisional agreement reached in trilogues”
items.reason: The European Parliament and the Council reached a provisional agreement on the SFDR 2.0 review on 19 November 2026.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-04: “Green Claims Commission officially withdraws the proposal”
items.reason: The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Withdrawn. The European Commission officially confirmed the withdrawal of the Green Claims Directive proposal in November 2026.”
items.reason: The European Commission officially withdrew the proposed directive.

items.text: Add the date 2026-11-20: “SFDR 2.0 provisional agreement reached between Council and Parliament”
items.reason: The European Parliament and Council reached a provisional political agreement on the SFDR revision in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Provisional agreement was reached between Council and Parliament on 20 November 2026. Formal adoption by both co-legislators is pending.”
items.reason: Trilogue negotiations concluded with a provisional agreement between Council and Parliament in November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “Applies. A provisional agreement on SFDR 2.0 was reached by EU co-legislators in November 2026.”
items.reason: Updating status text as trilogue negotiations for SFDR 2.0 concluded with a provisional agreement.

items.text: Change the stage from Adopted to In force
items.reason: The revised ESRS entered into force on 10 November 2026.

items.text: New status text: “In force since 10 November 2026. The revised ESRS apply from financial year 2027; the voluntary standard entered into force on 24 September 2026.”
items.reason: Updating status text to reflect that the 10 November 2026 entry into force date has passed.
